title: Curious if either of these places look familiar (one entrance of the mall, beach area)
content: Mall: I've been dreaming about "mallworld" for years and I almost always enter this way. Since I am more familiar with this area I thought I would map it out to see if anyone happens to recognize anything. The parking area is always large and packed with cars. There's never any parking close to the mall. If you try to park in the garage area good luck as it is a labyrinth and sometime has weapons that you have to dodge. You can enter the mall from below or ground level. This is one of the most quiet areas of the mall that usually has less people. To your right is a department store. It's disorganized and filled with a lot of items. The higher you go up, the more bizarre the floors become. I remember random empty areas, lights, and creatures on a higher floor once. Down the hall behind the department store into another section of the mall, you past toilets, food area (smaller food court) and it starts to turn into an open area of carnival games and arcade games like you would find at a movie theater, also a casino. I believe beyond that is a hotel but I've never been there. Next to the department store, heading into the direction of the middle of the mall is a women's apparel shop. It's always a women's apparel shop. The clothes and items might change but it's never something different. There's also another shop further down the corridor that is antiques that is usually the same as well. Beach: The shoreline that I made is just a small section. It goes further in both directions. There are also parts of the beach that have mounts of sand, and then rocky coastline. There are parts where it's shallow far out and people are standing out in the water half a mile out. There are pillars in the water or platforms that people will stand on for some reason. There are shacks and weird trees in one area of the beach, and further down there is cocktail service and a resort. There's also a wharf area and shops. One place is a really nice music shop with multiple floors and nice collectibles. Anyway, that might be too much lol I'm just excited I get to talk to others about this.
